pages.title: Hemiauchenia
pages.text: The Hemiauchenia ($(o)Hemiauchenia macrocephala$()) is an extinct camelid that lived across North America from the Pliocene until the end of the Pleistocene.$(br2)It belonged to the same branch of the camel family as the llamas, which originated in North America before spreading south.$(br2)It had long, slender legs, and is thought to have been a capable long-distance traveller over open country.
